## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-12-13: Form-of TRA filed as initial S-1 Exhibit 10.17
- 2014-02-05: TRA executed at IPO close among Malibu Boats, Inc., Malibu Boats Holdings LLC, and the pre-IPO Members
- 2014-02-11: IPO-closing 8-K Item 1.01 files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.4

#### Material accrual events

- 2014-2015: Follow-on offerings and a tender offer add ~$82.8M to the TRA liability
- 2017-Q1 FY2018: $6.0M upward adjustment for expanded state tax footprint from the Cobalt Boats acquisition
- 2017-Q2 FY2018: $30.3M downward adjustment for Tax Cuts and Jobs Act federal rate reduction

#### Annual pay-down phase

- FY2023: $4.0M payment; YE liability $43.5M
- FY2024: $4.2M payment; YE liability $40.6M
- FY2025: YE liability $40.2M

## Explanation

Malibu Boats, Inc. executed the TRA on February 5, 2014 at its Up-C IPO close, agreeing to pay 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by the IPO-time Original Sale and by subsequent exchanges of LLC Units in Malibu Boats Holdings LLC for Class A common stock, plus imputed interest on TRA payments, to the pre-IPO Members (including Black Canyon Capital sponsor vehicles). The contract has never been amended, restated, or terminated; the three post-IPO acquisitions (Cobalt 2017, Pursuit 2018, Maverick 2021) were stock or asset purchases that did not grant exchange rights and did not generate new TRAs, though Cobalt expanded the state tax footprint and triggered a $6.0M upward adjustment. The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act drove a one-time $30.3M downward remeasurement in fiscal Q2 2018, and annual payments since then have steadily reduced the liability from its $96.5M peak (June 2015) to $40.2M at June 30, 2025. The Up-C remains in place (12 Class B shares outstanding), so small annual increments from continuing exchanges are expected to continue. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
